title: The Importance of Tarbiyah in Truthfulness and Amanah for the Child
text_original:   ،ﺎﻬﻴﻋار وأ ﺎﻬِﺒ ﺣ ِ ﺎﺻ ﻦﻣ ﻚﻟذ ﻞُﺼُ ﺤﻳ ﺎﻤﻧإو ،ﺎﻬﻠ ِ ﺟ ْ ر ِ وأ ﺎﳖذ ُ أ ُ وأ  . ةًﺮﺷﺎﺒﻣ ﻪﻠﻌﻔﺑ وأ ﻪ ﻟﺎﻤﻫﺈﺑ ﺎ ﻣ . (٢٢٩ص ) ﻢﻴﱢﻘﻟا ﻦﺑﻻ « د ودﻮﳌا ﺔﹸﻔﲢ» (١) . text_simplified: The child is born upon a sound fitrah, but he may acquire incorrect behaviors such as lying due to flawed tarbiyah or the influence of the surrounding environment. Parents must guide their children toward truthfulness and amanah from a young age. They should also make du'a for the protection and success of their children from fitan.
